candidate.answerReason: The difference between four ratio parts and three ratio parts is one part, equal to 16 feet. The taller tree has four parts, so its height is 64 feet.

methods.label: Use equal ratio parts
methods.explanation:
The ratio \(3:4\) represents three equal height parts for the shorter tree and four of the same parts for the taller tree. Their difference is \(4-3=1\) part, so one part is \(16\) feet.

The taller tree has four parts, giving a height of
\[
4\cdot16=\boxed{64}\text{ feet},
\]
choice B.
methods.levelReason: Uses an elementary ratio-parts interpretation and multiplication.

candidate.annotationRationale: The target is interpreting the given ratio as a multiplicative relationship between the heights. Equal copies of a common part connect the ratio difference to 16 feet, with multiples supporting the final height calculation.
